Infundibulocystic basal cell carcinoma is a type of basal cell carcinoma, and MHIBCC is a syndrome characterized by multiple infundibulocystic basal cell carcinomas. Thus, 'Infundibulocystic basal cell carcinoma' is a broader category that includes the specific type of carcinoma seen in MHIBCC.

Basal cell nevus syndrome (Gorlin syndrome) is a distinct genetic disorder from Multiple hereditary infundibulocystic basal cell carcinoma syndrome, although both involve basal cell carcinomas. The genetic findings (SUFU mutation) and clinical presentation (infundibulocystic BCCs, no jaw cysts or palmar pits) in the vignette are more consistent with MHIBCC than classic Gorlin syndrome (PTCH1 mutation, jaw cysts, palmar pits).
